prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Your desktop companion is officially registered and ready to join your workspace.", "Verified Companion Registration"]
1: ["Preparing your pet desktop sanctuary...", "Welcome to Your Desktop Sanctuary", "Your pet has officially arrived and is settling onto your desktop environment.", "Enter Sanctuary"]
2: ["Next up: learn how to interact with your pet!", "How to Control Your Desktop Pet", "Right-click your pet anywhere on screen to open settings, hide the pet, or start a chat session.", "Next: Commands", "Pet Chat & Quick Actions", "Use desktop shortcuts or chat prompts to trigger pet animations and mini-interactions.", "Start Playing"]
3: ["Pick Your Companion Journey", "Select your path first to customize your onboarding setup."]
4: ["Signing in anchors your adopted pets safely to your account profile across reinstalls.", "All created and adopted pets remain linked to your account."]
5: ["Follow photo quality guidelines for best custom pet generation.", "Clear facial view, good lighting, single pet subject"]
6: ["Generating Your Desktop Pet", "You will receive a notification as soon as your pet is ready to appear on screen."]
7: ["Your Companion is Live!", "Welcome your new pet to your desktop workspace."]
8: ["Choose How You Want to Create Your Pet", "Pick a ready-made companion for instant setup or customize your own from photos.", "Continue Journey"]
9: ["Secure Desktop Pet Account Sign-In", "Connect your account to enable cloud saves, cross-device sync, and pet recovery.", "Cloud Backup Enabled"]
